challenge.method: Trace all three productions and GetValue. Compare undefined, null, false and a throwing base getter using a side effect in a computed key.
challenge.results: Every production tests null and undefined after successful base retrieval. False reaches the chain. A failed base retrieval occurs earlier and propagates, consistent with the condition. The local Node.js v24.4.1 diagnostic agreed. Null and undefined skipped key evaluation; false evaluated it; base getter threw.

limitations: The evaluation of a distinct expression surrounding the chain and the evaluation of the base are outside the short circuit.
